title: CLI End-to-End Tests
description: Integration tests spawning the real kaava binary.
body: End-to-end tests that spawn the real `kaava` binary, per `SCHEMATIFY-PRD.md` section 9.3 and Wave 9's acceptance condition: A duplicate marker token produces an error and exit code 1. `CARGO_BIN_EXE_kaava` is a cargo-provided environment variable naming the just-built binary for an integration test.
